text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm accompanying Super Creek back<n>to her dorm
after a day out together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, it really is kind of you to see<n>me all the
way back.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But you don't have to walk me to the<n>door.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I know you don't live very far from<n>here, but please
be careful on your<n>way home too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Super Creek turns away, I find<n>myself looking
up at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There are lots of stars out tonight.<n>They might look
even prettier if<n>viewed from somewhere darker.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as I'm here, perhaps I should<n>invite Super
Creek to go stargazing.<n>But...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I looked back and noticed you<n>spacing out, so I
couldn't help but<n>feel a bit concerned...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's too late to invite her out<n>stargazing,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I part ways with Super Creek and<n>head to the river.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As expected, there's not a soul in<n>sight at this hour.
I sit down to enjoy<n>the night sky, when...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I thought I might find you here.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I noticed your eyes twinkling as you<n>gazed at the
sky.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I had a hunch, so I figured I'd follow<n>it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...You were about to invite me to join<n>you, right?
choice_data_list: I just thought the stars looked beautiful tonight.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I knew it. You're always so<n>restrained.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If there's ever anything you want<n>from me, just
ask, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Holding back is a big no-no!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'd be a fool to turn down an<n>opportunity to spoil
you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek and I stargaze for a<n>while before
heading back home.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh? Hehe, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then let's just say that I was theone who wanted to see the stars withyou tonight.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let me stay by your side for just a<n>little bit longer,
okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You're even cute when<n>you're not being
upfront.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I feel like she sees right through me.<n>While things
are a little awkward, we<n>spend some time
stargazing together.
